name: hogar-sol-bingo
description: Bingo Benéfico Fundación Hogar Sol (cliente + servidor)

scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client && node scripts/ensure-env.mjs
scripts.server: node scripts/ensure-env.mjs && npm run dev --prefix server
scripts.test: npm test --prefix server && npm test --prefix client
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix server && npm run lint --prefix client
scripts.build:prod: npm ci --prefix server --omit=dev && npm ci --include=dev --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client
